entryHeader: // app.js — entry point of the Simujaules UI (DEM loading, map, compute
// dispatch, rendering, bundle I/O). It was one 13,000-line module until v82;
// the code now lives under app/, one module per concern, with the pure
// DOM-free helpers in lib/. No build step: the browser imports these files.
// EVALUATION ORDER IS PART OF THE CONTRACT. The modules' top-level code (the
// map, its panes, `state`, the DOM handles, every addEventListener) runs in
// the order listed below — the top-to-bottom order of the original file.
// Modules import each other freely (function declarations are hoisted across
// import cycles, exactly as they were inside one file), so that order is
// pinned by a chain instead: every module's FIRST import is its predecessor
// in this list, and this file imports the LAST module first.
// To add a module: put it in the list, make its first import the module
// before it, repoint the next module's first import at it, and add it to
// sw.js PRECACHE_URLS. A `let` shared across modules is assigned only through
// a setter in the module that declares it (imports are read-only bindings).
entryChainComment: // Walks the chain down to app/i18n.js and evaluates the modules in list order.
entryListComment: // Already evaluated by the line above — listed so the browser fetches them in
// parallel instead of discovering them one import at a time.

modules.name: i18n
desc: PT/EN STRINGS table, t(), applyTranslations(), setLang().
modules.short: PT/EN STRINGS table, t(), applyTranslations(), setLang()

modules.name: panel
desc: Side-panel plumbing: group highlights, label a11y, parameter persistence,
the physics → cost-bundle readout (readCost), config export/import/reset.
modules.short: group highlights, parameter persistence, readCost(), config I/O

modules.name: boot
desc: Worker/engine URLs, the style-dirty flag, and the DOMContentLoaded wiring
of every static control.
modules.short: worker/engine URLs, the DOMContentLoaded wiring of every control

modules.name: map
modules.anchor: // attributionControl:false — the on-map attribution strip is removed
desc: The Leaflet map: panes + layer order, address search, basemaps.
modules.short: the Leaflet map: panes + layer order, address search, basemaps

modules.name: state
desc: The shared `state` object, plus escapeHtml().
modules.short: the shared `state` object, escapeHtml()

modules.name: compute-source
desc: Compute source (Browser / Localhost / Cloud): URLs, headers,
cancelActiveCompute(), wedged-compute recovery.
modules.short: Browser / Localhost / Cloud: URLs, cancelActiveCompute()

modules.name: dom
desc: DOM handles used across the app (status line, run button, progress bar…).
modules.short: shared DOM handles (status line, run button, progress bar…)

modules.name: dem
desc: DEM loading: file / URL / example DEMs, the FABDEM viewport loader,
crop + downsample, loadDemFromArrayBuffer().
modules.short: DEM loading: file / URL / FABDEM viewport, crop, downsample

modules.name: network
desc: Vector network: GeoPackage read/write, input-dataset export/import,
rasterisation, the Overpass and FlatGeobuf street pulls.
modules.short: vector network: GeoPackage, Overpass + FlatGeobuf street pulls

modules.name: bridges
desc: OSM / FlatGeobuf bridges and tunnels → portal edges (group 1D).
modules.short: bridges and tunnels → portal edges (group 1D)

modules.name: draw
desc: On-map drawing (Leaflet-Geoman): impassable polygons, portal bridges,
the bridge overlay, clearVectorNetwork().
modules.short: on-map drawing (Geoman): impassable polygons, portal bridges

modules.name: water
desc: Impassable mask: the OSM / FlatGeobuf water pulls (group 1C), mask files,
corridor availability.
modules.short: impassable mask: water pulls (group 1C), mask files

modules.name: network-view
desc: Network line overlay, snapToNetwork(), lat/lng ↔ DEM pixel conversion.
modules.short: network line overlay, snapToNetwork(), lat/lng ↔ pixel

modules.name: graph-mode
desc: Graph mode ("follow the vectors"): graph token, route comparison,
graph energy/passes rasterisation and overlay.
modules.short: graph mode ("follow the vectors") and its overlay

modules.name: points
desc: Map clicks → source / destination / reference points: markers, the
reference set with undo/redo, Sobol/Halton and census placement, ref I/O.
modules.short: map clicks → source / destination / reference points, census

modules.name: run
desc: The Run button: builds the compute message, dispatches to workers / wasm /
backend, merges density pools — and renderResult().
modules.short: the Run handler: message build, dispatch, pool merge; renderResult()

modules.name: kpi
desc: Accessibility KPIs (3B) from the ref↔ref energy matrix, and their CSV exports.
modules.short: accessibility KPIs (3B) and their CSV exports

modules.name: maxseg
desc: Max-density segment (3C.c): coarsening, the worker run, stroke rendering.
modules.short: max-density segment (3C.c)

modules.name: render
modules.anchor: // Re-render the cached energy + passes overlays with the currently-selected
desc: Field rendering: energy / passes / relief / impassable overlays, layer
controls, legend ticks and range inputs. Style-only — never recomputes.
modules.short: field / relief / impassable overlays, layer controls, legend

modules.name: refgeom
desc: Reference geometry: the GPX track overlay and its energy metrics.
modules.short: reference geometry: the GPX overlay and its energy

modules.name: engines
modules.anchor: // Shared conservative memory budget (bytes) for browser worker pools
desc: Engine sizing and choice: memory budget, densityPoolSize(), the
WebAssembly engine selection, backend capabilities, compute-source UI.
modules.short: memory budget, densityPoolSize(), WebAssembly engine choice

modules.name: cloud
desc: Cloud compute: the VM state machine (start, keep-alive, stop).
modules.short: cloud compute: the VM state machine

modules.name: estimate
modules.anchor: // Calibration probe: each ref runs an UNBUDGETED search stopped after
desc: Run-time estimate: calibration probe, predictComputeMs(), the online
correction, and the duration / byte / energy formatters.
modules.short: run-time estimate: probe, predictComputeMs(), formatters

modules.name: colormaps
desc: Colormaps: the ColorCET tables, colormap(), route colours, the legend.
modules.short: ColorCET tables, colormap(), route colours, the legend

modules.name: geotiff
desc: GeoTIFF read/write helpers shared by the dataset and bundle I/O.
modules.short: GeoTIFF read/write helpers

modules.name: grid
desc: The compute grid: mask GeoTIFF read/resample, bridge corridors,
buildComputeGrid(), buildPortals(), deck pass stamping.
modules.short: the compute grid: mask resample, corridors, buildPortals()

modules.name: bundle
desc: Bundle export/import: metadata.jsonld, route GeoJSON, rendered images,
downloadBundle(), loadBundleFile(), applyMetadataToUI().
modules.short: bundle export/import: metadata.jsonld, GeoJSON, images
